title: Mold Remediation Debris Class and Per-Load Haul Fees
content:
Bagged Mold Remediation debris is hauled at a per-load fee set by the debris class, which follows the water category on the linked company Water Damage Mitigation job.

Growth behind a linked company water job of water Category 3 is hauled as contaminated debris at the contaminated load fee of 289.00 per load; growth behind a linked water job of Category 2 is hauled at the gray load fee of 241.00 per load; every other job is hauled at the tier's debris disposal fee per load.

| Linked water job's category | Debris class | Per-load fee |
|---|---|---|
| Category 3 | Contaminated | 289.00 |
| Category 2 | Gray | 241.00 |
| Category 1, or no linked water job | Ordinary | The tier's debris disposal fee per load |

Each load is billed at the per-load fee of its class: every load behind a Category 3 water job at 289.00, every load behind a Category 2 water job at 241.00.
